options.command: BASE_REF=""; if git rev-parse --verify --quiet main >/dev/null; then BASE_REF="main"; elif git rev-parse --verify --quiet origin/main >/dev/null; then BASE_REF="origin/main"; fi; if [ -n "$BASE_REF" ] && git ls-tree -r --name-only "$BASE_REF" -- proto 2>/dev/null | grep -q '\.proto$'; then pnpm exec buf breaking --against "../../../.git#ref=${BASE_REF},subdir=libs/ui/proto-ui-contracts"; else echo "Skipping buf breaking: no baseline UI proto files found on main/origin/main."; fi
